-----Original Message-----
From: Crain's Cleveland Business Daily <newsletter@crainscleveland.com>
Subject: Ohio manufacturer loses $1.2M to vendor email scam

A Toledo-area manufacturer wired $1.2 million to criminals after receiving emails that appeared to come from a long-time supplier. According to the complaint, the messages said the supplier had "recently changed banks" and asked that "all outstanding and future invoices be remitted to the new account at Regions Bank." The emails came from a domain that differed from the supplier's by a single letter.

The company's bank was able to recover about $300,000. Experts recommend out-of-band verification for every change to a supplier's payment information...
